title: Thinking under check
objectives: Learn a reliable order to check your options when in check
Practice blocking a check and following up
Practice converting a material advantage into checkmate

steps.text: There are only ever three ways to answer a check — capture the checking piece, block the line of attack, or move your king to safety. Working through them in that order, every time, keeps you from missing your best option under pressure.
Let's put 'block the check' into practice. White is in check from the rook on e8. There's no way to capture it, so the knight has to block the line — then be ready for what happens next.

steps.objective: Checkmate the lone black king using your rook and king.

steps.summary: Capture, block, or move — in that order, every time you're in check. And when the position is winning, remember checkmate is the goal, not just winning material.
